```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read in the data of the models 
```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds"))
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicbest.rds"))
# Define models converging that have a sine function 
df_converged <- filter(waic_df, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seonlyseropos_s08"), 
                       mod_out == "imm", str_detect(mod_name, "cs")) 
```

# Read in data and assess gaps and missing data ====================================================
```{r}
all_datagaps <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Select the model 
    dat_mod <- filter(df_converged, mod == x)
    sens <- case_when(dat_mod$dat == "semeth_s08" ~ "semeth",
                      dat_mod$dat == "seonlytemp_s08" ~ "seonlytemp", 
                      dat_mod$dat == "seonlyseropos_s08" ~ "seonlyseropos", 
                      .default = "")
    # Read in data
    dat_raw <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modfit, "/data", sens, "_brms_", dat_mod$pat[[1]], "_v", 
                              dat_mod$vac[[1]], "_s08.rds"))
    
    str_remove_all(str_subset(names(dat_raw), "imm_val_s1"), "imm_val_s1_anti_|_")
    
    # Create clu in the data 
    if(!str_detect(x, "csi")) {
      dat_raw <- mutate(dat_raw, clu = NA) 
      } else {
      dat_raw <- rename(dat_raw, clu = all_of(filter(df_converged, mod == x)$reg[[1]])) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu))
      }
    # Identify gaps and missing data 
    dat_gap <- expand.grid(vac_week_v1 = 1:52,
                           clu = unique(dat_raw$clu),
                           imm_name = str_remove_all(str_subset(names(dat_raw), "imm_val_s1"), 
                                                     "imm_val_s1|_anti_|_")) %>%
      # Create df of total values per week
      left_join(dat_raw %>%
                  group_by(vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
                  summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
                  group_by(clu) %>%
                  mutate(checkgaps = fun_checkgaps(vac_week_v1)) %>%
                  ungroup(),
                by = join_by(vac_week_v1, clu)) %>%
      select(clu, everything()) %>%
      mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " "),
             imm_name = na_if(as.character(imm_name), ""),
             pi_vac_week_v1 = round(vac_week_v1 * (2*pi/52), digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(checkgaps_all = replace_na(checkgaps, TRUE),
             checkgaps_all = all(checkgaps_all))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod")
})
```

# Extract mean cos and sin coefficients of the sine wave ===========================================
```{r}
all_coefcosine <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefcosine.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Read in the coeficients 
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$coef}/coef_{x}"))$fixed %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "parameter") %>%
      # Coefficients of the intercepts, cos and sin
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "Int|reg|cos|sin")) %>%
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "sd_", negate = TRUE))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi)
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (param, imm_name, clu) -----------------------------------------------
    mutate(
      # Remove strings pi_vac_week_v1 and :
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "pi_vac_week_v1|:"),
      # Define parameter type (int, p_cos, p_sin)
      param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos",
                        str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin",
                        .default = "int"),
      # Remove strings parameter type 
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "Intercept|cos|sin"),
      # Define immunogenicity name between immvals1anti and _
      imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"), 
      # Remove strings immunogenicity name
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, paste0("immvals1anti", imm_name, "_")),
      # Remove strings reg 
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, reg), 
      # Define cluster name and reference value 
      clu = case_when(str_detect(reg, "reg_2") & parameter == "" ~ "1_North",
                      str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") & parameter == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
                      !is.na(reg) & parameter != "" ~ parameter)) %>%
    select(pat, mod, param, mod_name, reg, clu, imm_name, Estimate, mod_out, dat, vac, gauss, 
           pat_tidy, multi) %>%
    # Obtain cos and sin per clu -------------------------------------------------------------------
    pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>% 
    group_by(mod, reg, imm_name) %>%
    mutate(
      inti = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(int)),  
      p_cosi = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(p_cos)),  
      p_sini = if_else(row_number() == 1, 0, first(p_sin))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      int = int + inti,
      p_cos = p_cos + p_cosi,
      p_sin = p_sin + p_sini) %>%
    select(-c(inti, p_cosi, p_sini)) %>%
    # Estimate amplitude and phase -----------------------------------------------------------------
    mutate(amp_ls = fun_amp_ls(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int),
           phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, phi_type = "week"),
           amp = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "amp_ns"),
           mu_ns = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "mu_ns")) %>%
    # Bring together with the data gaps and fix names ----------------------------------------------
    left_join(distinct(all_datagaps, mod, clu, imm_name, checkgaps_all), 
              by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name)) %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_mean"), .cols = c(int, p_cos, p_sin, amp_ls, amp, phi, mu_ns))
  })
```







# Read conditional effects =========================================================================
These are the mean estimates with the conditional intervals predicted per week and cluster.

```{r}
# Read in conditional effects with data 
all_ceffects <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_ceffects.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Read in conditional effects
    ce_effects <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$ceffects}/ce_{x}")) %>%
      mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
      rename(ceffect_mean = estimate__, ceffect_lower = lower__, ceffect_upper = upper__, ceffect_se = se__)
    # Create clu in the data 
    if(!str_detect(x, "csi")) {
      ce_effects <- mutate(ce_effects, clu = NA) 
      } else {
      ce_effects <- rename(ce_effects, clu = all_of(filter(df_converged, mod == x)$reg[[1]])) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu))
      }
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    # Combine in a single data frame 
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " ")) %>%
    left_join(all_datagaps, by = join_by(mod, pi_vac_week_v1, clu, imm_name)) %>%
    left_join(all_coefcosine, by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name, checkgaps_all))
})
```

# Explorative plot: Conditional effects
```{r}
plceffects_l <- sapply(str_subset(unique(waic_best$mod_best), "base", negate = TRUE), function(x) {
  all_ceffects %>%
    filter(mod == x, checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = ceffect_mean, color = phi_mean, fill = phi_mean)) + 
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ceffect_lower, ymax = ceffect_upper), alpha = 0.2, color = "white") + 
      geom_line() + 
      geom_point(data = filter(all_ceffects, mod == x, !is.na(tot), checkgaps == FALSE),
                 aes(y = -Inf), alpha = 0.4, shape = "|", size = 6) +
      scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect\non ab titers") + 
      scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1, 18, 35, 52), limits = c(1,52)) + 
      scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing", limits = c(0, 52), colors = c(viridis(6, begin = 0, option = "C"),
                                                 rev(viridis(7, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
                            aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
      facet_wrap(.~clu, scales = "free", nrow = 1) + 
      ggtitle(x)
}, simplify = FALSE)

# Plot for only main pathogens
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")

plceffects_l[str_subset(str_subset(names(plceffects_l), paste(pat_sel, collapse = "|")), "multi",
                        negate = TRUE)]
```

# Relationship between the coefficients (in red) and the conditional effects (in black)
```{r}
all_ceffects %>%
  filter(mod == "bmv1_s08_vzv_cs.rds") %>%
  mutate(coefestimate = int_mean + (p_cos_mean*cos(2*pi*vac_week_v1/52)) + (p_sin_mean*sin(2*pi*vac_week_v1/52))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = coefestimate)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_line(data = filter(all_ceffects, mod == "bmv1_s08_vzv_cs.rds"), 
            aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = log(ceffect_mean)), color = "black") + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = amp_mean), color = "red") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = phi_mean), color = "red") + 
  geom_line(aes(y = coefestimate), color = "red")

all_ceffects %>%
  filter(mod == "bmv1_s08_vzv_cs.rds") %>%
  mutate(coefestimate = exp(int_mean + (p_cos_mean*cos(2*pi*vac_week_v1/52)) + (p_sin_mean*sin(2*pi*vac_week_v1/52)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = coefestimate)) + 
  geom_line(data = filter(all_ceffects, mod == "bmv1_s08_vzv_cs.rds"), 
            aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = ceffect_mean), color = "black") + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = amp_mean), color = "red") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = phi_mean), color = "red") + 
  geom_line(aes(y = coefestimate), color = "red")
```

# Extract spaghetti conditional effects ============================================================
```{r}
all_cespa <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_cespa.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) readRDS(glue("{dirs$cespa}/cespa_{x}")), simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    # Obtain clu, imm_name and fix pi_week
    mutate(clu = coalesce(reg_2, reg_3, reg_4, reg_6),
           clu = str_remove_all(clu, " "),
           imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=immvals1anti).+?(?=\\.)"),
           pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    rename(spa_no = sample__, spa_estimate = estimate__, spa_estimate_norm = est_norm) %>%
    # Select only necessary columns
    select(mod, clu, imm_name, spa_no, pi_vac_week_v1, spa_estimate, spa_estimate_norm) %>%
    # Add pat, reg and mean estimates --------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(all_ceffects, by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1)) %>%
    group_by(pat, mod, reg, clu, imm_name) %>%
    mutate(ceffect_mean_norm = ceffect_mean/mean(ceffect_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Fix imm_name names ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(tidy_names_imm, by = join_by(imm_name)) %>%
    mutate(imm_name_tidy = replace_na(imm_name_tidy, ""), 
           imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, ""))
})
```

# Plot the spaguetti 

# Create spaguetti plots per pathogen, immunogenicity, region and cluster and save them  
```{r}
newplots <- TRUE
if(newplots == TRUE) {
walk(c("reg_6", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2"), function(x) {
  # Identify clusters per region and pathogen
  patclu_l <- filter(all_cespa, reg == x, dat == "s08", checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
    distinct(pat, clu, imm_name)
  
  # Plot each of the combinations
  pl_l <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(patclu_l$pat)) {
    # Plot it 
    pl_l[[i]] <- all_cespa %>%
      filter(reg == x, clu == patclu_l$clu[i], pat == patclu_l$pat[i], imm_name == patclu_l$imm_name[i],
             dat == "s08", checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = spa_estimate_norm, group = spa_no, color = phi_mean)) + 
      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
      geom_line(aes(y = ceffect_mean_norm, group = 1), size = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        "Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
      scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect") + 
      scale_color_gradientn(
        "Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), 
        colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "D"), rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "D"))),
        guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = -Inf), shape = "|", size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(imm_name_tidy~paste0(pat_tidy, ", Region ", str_remove(x, "reg_"), " (", 
                                    str_remove_all(clu, "_|1|2|3|4|5|6"),")"),
               scales = "free_y") + 
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  # Define name of the multivariate models
  n_imm_name <- if(patclu_l$imm_name[i] != "")  paste0("_", patclu_l$imm_name[i])
  # Save plot
  ggsave(pl_l[[i]], width = 5, height = 5,
         file = paste0("../figures/spa_perpatclu/ce_", x, "_", patclu_l$pat[i], n_imm_name, "_", 
         patclu_l$clu[i], ".pdf"))
  }
})
}
```

# Create spaguetti plots per region and cluster and save them 
```{r}
lapply(c("reg_6", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2"), function(x) {
  # Identify clusters per region and pathogen
  clu_l <- filter(all_cespa, reg == x, dat == "s08", pat %in% pat_sel, checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
    distinct(clu)
  
  # Plot each of the combinations
  pl_l <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(clu_l$clu)) {
    # Plot it 
    pl_l[[clu_l$clu[i]]] <- all_cespa %>%
      filter(reg == x, clu == clu_l$clu[i], dat == "s08", pat %in% pat_sel, checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = spa_estimate_norm, group = spa_no, color = phi_mean)) + 
      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
      geom_line(aes(y = ceffect_mean_norm, group = 1), size = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        "Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
      scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect") + 
      scale_color_gradientn(
        "Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), 
        colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "D"), rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "D"))),
        guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = -Inf), shape = "|", size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~paste0(pat_tidy, ", Region ", str_remove(x, "reg_"), " (", str_remove_all(clu, "_|1|2|3|4|5|6"),")"),
               scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) + 
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  # Check how many pathogens
  npat <- length(unique(filter(all_cespa, reg == x, clu == clu_l$clu[i], 
                               dat == "s08", pat %in% pat_sel, checkgaps == FALSE)$pat))
  # Save plot
  ggsave(pl_l[[clu_l$clu[i]]], width = case_when(npat < 4 ~ npat*3, .default = 12), 
         height = 2 + 2*ceiling(npat/4), file = paste0("../figures/spa_perclu/ce_", x, "_", clu_l$clu[i], ".pdf"))
  }
  return(pl_l)
})
```

# Create spaguetti plots per region and pathogen and save them 
```{r}
lapply(c("reg_6", "reg_4", "reg_3", "reg_2"), function(x) {
  # Identify clusters per region and pathogen
  pat_l <- filter(all_cespa, reg == x, dat == "s08", pat %in% pat_sel, checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
    distinct(pat, pat_tidy)
  
  # Plot each of the combinations
  pl_l <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(pat_l$pat)) {
    # Plot it 
    pl_l[[pat_l$pat[i]]] <- all_cespa %>%
      filter(reg == x, pat == pat_l$pat[i], dat == "s08", pat %in% pat_sel, checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
      mutate(clu = factor(clu, levels = sort(unique(clu)))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = spa_estimate_norm, group = spa_no, color = phi_mean)) + 
      geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
      geom_line(aes(y = ceffect_mean_norm, group = 1), size = 1) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        "Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
      scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect") + 
      scale_color_gradientn(
        "Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), 
        colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "D"), rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "D"))),
        guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = -Inf), shape = "|", size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~reorder(str_remove_all(clu, "_|1|2|3|4|5|6"), as.numeric(clu)),
               scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) + 
    theme(legend.position = "top") + 
    ggtitle(paste0(pat_l$pat_tidy[i], ", Region ", str_remove(x, "reg_")))
  # Check how many clusters
  nclu <- length(unique(filter(all_cespa, reg == x, pat == pat_l$pat[i], 
                               dat == "s08", pat %in% pat_sel, checkgaps == FALSE)$clu))
  # Save plot
  ggsave(pl_l[[pat_l$pat[i]]], width = case_when(nclu < 4 ~ nclu*3, .default = 9), 
         height = 2 + 2*ceiling(nclu/3), file = paste0("../figures/spa_perpat/ce_", x, "_", pat_l$pat[i], ".pdf"))
  }
  return(pl_l)
})
```
